newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun Hotels to replace Glynhill.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Hotels to replace Glynhill.

text.p: Hotel concern Glynhill International Ltd said Tuesday it had proposed a restructuring that would make it a wholly owned subsidiary of Bermuda- incorporated Lai Sun Hotels International Ltd.
It said Glynhill's listing would be withdrawn and replaced by Lai Sun Hotels. Glynhill shareholders would receive one Lai Sun Hotel share for every eight Glynhill shares.
The company said the reorganisation would allow greater flexibility for expansion overseas, with an offshore legal domicile enhancing international standing.
Glynhill was about 54 percent owned by Lai Sun Development Co Ltd as of March.
Glynhill said the proposals were conditional on shareholder and stock exchange approval.
Its shares rose HK$0.02 to HK$0.32 at midday.

Glynhill associate Delta Hotels Ltd and its subsidiary Delta Asia Ltd have hotel management interests in North America and the Asia-Pacific. Another subsidiary, Chains International Hotels Management Ltd, has hotel management interests in China and Vietnam.
